name: elements_find
title: Find elements
description: Find elements of the open IFC model by class, storey, name or property value. Returns their ids for elements_isolate and element_properties. (Permission: read.)

class.description: IFC class, e.g. IfcWall (case does not matter).

storey.description: Storey name, exactly as the model names it.

property.description: A property (or quantity) value. Without "set", any set holding a property of that name.

rules.description: BimCraft Find rules; field = cls, type, storey, material, name, longname, objtype, tag, predefined, guid or p:<Set>.<Property>.

mode.description: all = every rule must match (default), any = one is enough.

name: elements_isolate
title: Isolate, hide or show elements
description: Change what the 3D view shows: isolate (only these), ghost (these, the rest see-through), hide (these), or show_all. Visibility only: the model is not changed. (Permission: edit.)

class.description: IFC class, e.g. IfcWall (case does not matter).

storey.description: Storey name, exactly as the model names it.

property.description: A property (or quantity) value. Without "set", any set holding a property of that name.

rules.description: BimCraft Find rules; field = cls, type, storey, material, name, longname, objtype, tag, predefined, guid or p:<Set>.<Property>.

mode.description: all = every rule must match (default), any = one is enough.

name: element_properties
title: Element properties
description: Attributes, type name, property sets and quantity sets of one element of the open IFC model (type sets included). (Permission: read.)

name: app_info
title: About this window
description: BimCraft's window: the IFC file open, unsaved changes, whether Draw is on, levels and elements, and what the person is in the middle of. (Permission: read.)

name: materials_list
title: Inspect project materials
description: Stable material IDs, exact defaults in mm, version diagnostics. Reads never migrate or write records. (Permission: read.)

name: assemblies_list
title: Inspect wall assemblies
description: Built-in and authored wall keys, stored type GlobalIds, exact exterior-to-interior recipes and core flags in mm. Invalid records are diagnostics, never selectable fallbacks. (Permission: read.)

name: material_create
title: material_create
description: Create a project material; retain unused definitions. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. (Permission: edit.)

defaultThickness.description: mm. A library default; never resizes existing recipe layers.

name: material_edit
title: material_edit
description: Edit an explicitly identified project material; defaults do not change instance layer widths. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. (Permission: edit.)

defaultThickness.description: mm. A library default; never resizes existing recipe layers.

name: assembly_create
title: assembly_create
description: Create an unused authored assembly. Layers have explicit material IDs and mm widths. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. (Permission: edit.)

t.description: Explicit mm; zero only for material membranes.

layers.description: Ordered exterior to interior. One contiguous physical core.

name: assembly_edit
title: assembly_edit
description: Edit an authored assembly in place; ALL instances of that type follow, preserving their location anchors. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. (Permission: edit.)

t.description: Explicit mm; zero only for material membranes.

layers.description: Ordered exterior to interior. One contiguous physical core.

name: assembly_duplicate
title: assembly_duplicate
description: Copy a discovered built-in or authored assembly to a new key and GlobalId. No instance is assigned implicitly. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. (Permission: edit.)

name: walls_edit
title: walls_edit
description: Change only walls identified by GlobalId, including authored type assignment, six location lines, exterior side and existing height/top settings. No join/end or reference-dimension editing. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. (Permission: edit.)

type.description: Dynamic key from assemblies_list or model_describe; no built-in fallback.

topLevel.description: Exact storey GlobalId. Mutually exclusive with height.

name: wall_joins_get
title: Inspect wall joins
description: Persisted/effective A/B controls, record classification, raw-mm physical profiles and full-neighborhood diagnostics. Eligibility does not certify cleaned joining. Reads never migrate. (Permission: read.)

name: wall_join_diagnostics
title: Inspect join diagnostics
description: Exactly one of walls or storey GlobalId. Inspect complete participating storeys, then filter. Stable codes, raw mm; no guessed neighbors or end IDs. Never migrates records. (Permission: read.)

name: wall_join_end_set
title: Change one wall end
description: Change allow/cap on stable analytic end a or b using changeWall, regeneration and ordinary history. Internal node/tee relations and untouched end are retained. Same values on absent/legacy records explicitly migrate in one undoable step; supported same values are a no-op. (Permission: edit.)

name: model_describe
title: Describe the model
description: The open BimCraft model in millimetres: its levels (name, GlobalId, elevation, height), walls by type, doors, windows, rooms with their areas, floors drawn by outline, ramps, grid line tags, columns and the site; also the wall, door and window types walls_add and opening_add take. (Permission: read.)

name: walls_list
title: List walls
description: The walls on a level that BimCraft's Draw tools can change: GlobalId, start and end (mm, in the level's plan), type, thickness, height, length, and the doors and windows in each. (Permission: read.)

level.description: A level by its name or GlobalId (default: the level at elevation 0, else the lowest).

name: walls_add
title: Add walls
description: Walls along points (mm, in the level's plan) on a level, joined to each other and to the walls there; rooms, floors and roofs follow as with the Wall tool. closed: true runs the last wall back to the first point. Type: one of model_describe's wall types (default ext-2x6). Height: mm, or leave it out to run up to the level above (the level's height on the top level). One undo step. (Permission: edit.)

level.description: A level by its name or GlobalId (default: the level at elevation 0, else the lowest).

type.description: Dynamic key from assemblies_list or model_describe; no built-in fallback.

topLevel.description: Exact storey GlobalId. Mutually exclusive with height.

name: opening_add
title: Add a door or window
description: A door or window in a wall (its GlobalId from walls_list or walls_add): type from model_describe (default a single door / a fixed window), offset = mm from the wall's start to the opening's near edge (default: the middle), width and height in mm (default: the type's), sill for windows. Refused if it does not fit. One undo step. (Permission: edit.)

name: floor_add
title: Add a floor
description: A floor or slab of any outline (mm, in the level's plan; at least three corners, not crossing itself) on a level: kind concrete | wood, use floor | slab, thickness in mm (default the kind's), offset = its top above the level (mm). One undo step. (Permission: edit.)

level.description: A level by its name or GlobalId (default: the level at elevation 0, else the lowest).

name: levels_add
title: Add levels
description: Levels at these heights above the lowest level (mm); a height a level already has is skipped. Names follow the model's ("Level 3"). One undo step. (Permission: edit.)

name: grid_add
title: Add grid lines
description: Grid lines laid out as Build › Grid does: numbered lines (u: count and spacing in mm, a number or one per bay) and lettered lines (v), from an origin (mm, in the level's plan), turned by angle (degrees), each running extend mm past the last crossing. Added to the model's grid (one per building). One undo step. (Permission: edit.)

level.description: A level by its name or GlobalId (default: the level at elevation 0, else the lowest).

name: element_set
title: Set a name or property
description: Change one element (by GlobalId): an attribute (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag), or one property value by its name (and set name, when two sets have it). The value keeps the property's IFC type (numbers stay numbers). A value the element shares with others is copied for it first; a property of the element's type changes every element of that type and needs type: true. One undo step. (Permission: edit.)

name: elements_delete
title: Delete elements
description: Delete elements by GlobalId, as one undo step. Walls, doors, windows and floors drawn with BimCraft's tools go through the Draw module (walls close up, rooms and joins follow); any other element goes with its parts and openings. Levels, the building and the site are not deleted. Drawn and other elements go in separate calls. (Permission: edit.)

name: elements_move
title: Move elements
description: Move elements (by GlobalId) by [dx, dy, dz] millimetres in the model's axes (x east, y north, z up on an unturned model), as one undo step; what is hosted on them or placed relative to them moves along. A wall drawn with BimCraft's tools moves with wall_change (its ends), a door or window along its wall with opening_change. (Permission: edit.)

name: wall_change
title: Change a wall
description: Change a wall drawn with BimCraft's tools (GlobalId from walls_list): its start a and end b (mm, in its level's plan) and/or its type. Joined walls, rooms and its doors and windows follow; a door that no longer fits refuses the change. One undo step. (Permission: edit.)

type.description: Dynamic key from assemblies_list or model_describe; no built-in fallback.

name: opening_change
title: Change a door or window
description: Change a door or window (GlobalId): offset = mm from its wall's start to its near edge, width, height, sill (windows), type (of the same kind), or wall = another wall's GlobalId to move it there. Refused if it does not fit. One undo step. (Permission: edit.)

name: selection_get
title: What is selected
description: What the person has selected in BimCraft: GlobalId, class and name of each (up to 1000). (Permission: read.)

name: selection_set
title: Select
description: Select elements by GlobalId to show them to the person (replace, add or remove). Changes nothing in the model. (Permission: edit.)

name: undo
title: Undo
description: Undo the assistant's last steps (labelled "Assistant: …"); steps the person made are only undone with any: true. (Permission: edit.)

name: redo
title: Redo
description: Redo an Assistant-owned model step. Person steps require any: true. (Permission: edit.)

name: model_save
title: Save the model
description: BimCraft's own Save as IFC: a new file with every change (desktop: the save dialog; browser: a download). The original file is never changed. (Permission: save.)
